chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Asbury Park summer show
summary: He mentions joining Barnet, then recalls a summer show in Asbury Park with a drummer named Steve and Cotton Club performers, and the Rhythm Club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I did join Charlie Barnet's band after that. Peanuts Holland was in it; Andy Gibson was the arranger...
Wait. In here we've got that for a time you worked in Asbury Park with a small group.
Oh! You've got it right. The drummer, Steve....
Washington?
It wasn't Steve?
No.

He had a band, and he used some of the Cotton Club kids, Savannah Churchill, (?)Bronson Guy(?)/found some guys(?) to do a show in Asbury Park at that time. Steve... what was his last name? He was the brother of a drummer who apparently was involved in the assassination of Jim Europe. He was a short little dark fellow, but he was always nice to me. We got along just great. But ...(?)...(?)... with him, of course. From the Rhythm Club; I met him at the Rhythm Club. (The Rhythm Club was another institution that we should speak about.) And he got the show together and stayed in Asbury Park for the summer, with Jim(?) Collins, who was dancer-MC... There were a few acts.
Every summer we had... You know, in those days, we had different places to go. Atlantic City, Asbury Park for a while...
Ramirez - 82
Is Asbury Park actually on the sea?
Yeah, near the sea.
Is it on the sea?
There's Ocean City...
Oh, it is. I've been there, but I didn't realize... So it's like a small Atlantic City.
Right. And the adjourning little town, it's called Belmar, is where we could go for a vacation and rest up or something.
Well, the race track is there, isn't it? Isn't there a big race track?
I don't know. Monmouth?
Isn't there a big race track at Asbury Park?
I wasn't that interested in horses then, so I wouldn't know. It was beautiful, because through there...
[END OF TAPE 2, SIDE B]
